article.title: Tu brasileño frente a tú y vos guatemaltecos

claims.summary: The article introduces the differences between the use of 'tu' in Brazilian Portuguese and 'tú/vos' in Guatemalan Spanish.

claims.sectionKey: En Brasil pueden coexistar tu vais y tu vai
claims.summary: In Brazil, both 'tu vais' and 'tu vai' can coexist.

claims.sectionKey: En algunas regiones brasileñas, tu conserva segunda persona verbal; en otras usa formas de tercera
claims.summary: In some Brazilian regions, 'tu' maintains second person verbal forms, while in others uses third person forms.

claims.sectionKey: En Guatemala, vos tiene su propio paradigma: vos vas, vos tenés, vos podés, distinto tanto de tu vais portugués como de tú vas español
claims.summary: In Guatemala, 'vos' has its own paradigm, which is different from both 'tu vais' in Portuguese and 'tú vas' in Spanish.

claims.sectionKey: Las relaciones de cercanía, respeto y región también cambian
claims.summary: The article mentions that relationships of closeness, respect, and region also change.
